annotations.title: Look up a Georgia General Assembly bill

description: One bill or resolution of the Georgia General Assembly by number in any written form (HB 136, H.B. 136, House Bill 136, 2025-2026/hb136, a numeric id), as the same Markdown twin the site serves: frontmatter (cite_as, canonical_url, source_url, status), the verbatim text, the summaries Georgia Commons wrote under a heading that says so, and status. With no `session`, a number means the newest regular session that has it; name the session (2026-special) for a special session's bill that shares its number. `full` adds the history, the floor votes with how each member voted, the amendments, and every document the legislature lists. Returns at most `max_chars` characters (default 60,000); a longer bill ends with the call for the next part.

bill.description: The bill or resolution: HB 136, H.B. 136, House Bill 136, SR 5, 2025-2026/hb136, or a numeric id.
bill.title: Bill

full.description: Include the optional material the tool describes (for example votes and history, or the notes). Longer.
full.title: Full

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call, 1,000 to 200,000 (default 60,000). A longer document ends with a pointer to the next part.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

session.description: The session, named by its years or slug: 2025-2026 (the regular session) or 2026-special. Omit for the default the tool describes.
session.title: Session

start.description: Where to start, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the beginning.
start.title: Start
